about: Cute Cat Hehe / Not Hehe is a two-row comparison with the same tiny gray and white kitten on the left of each row. In the top row the kitten has a tiny open-mouthed smile and the caption "hehe"; in the bottom row its mouth is shut, its eyes slightly narrowed and the caption reads "not hehe". The empty white boxes to the right are for whatever causes each mood. The difference between the two faces is small but unmistakable, which fits the meme's purpose: comparing two things that look alike but feel completely different, such as a fun notification and a terrible one.
origin: The kitten photos spread on social media around 2021, and the side-by-side hehe and not hehe layout was then shared as a blank comparison template.
usage:
The first box fills the white space beside "hehe" with the thing that makes you happy. The second fills the space beside "not hehe" with its slightly worse twin. You can write text or describe an image there.

The joke is strongest when the two items are nearly identical, so the drop in mood comes from one small detail: "pr approved" versus "pr with 40 comments", "day off" versus "day off spent sick". Keep it gentle; this kitten is mildly annoyed, not furious.
ideas: "we need to talk" from a friend about a party
"we need to talk" from my boss
free fries at the bottom of the bag
a receipt at the bottom of the bag
my team scores an own goal
